summary: StudioTally Pro fully tested end-to-end. Backend (REST + WebSocket) 12/12 tests pass on public URL. Frontend two-context flow works: session create/join with 5-char code, real-time device_list broadcasts, régie PGM/PVW/BLACKOUT (verified live border color rgb(255,51,51) and reset to rgb(42,42,42)), targeted alarm A->all delivered to B with router.push to /alert showing message + MAINTENIR POUR ARRÊTER hold button, OBS form renders and shows ÉCHEC status + error banner on unreachable IP, Settings modal (device name + Son/Vibration/Flash toggles) works, /tally?mode=session shows STANDBY/PREVIEW/LIVE per current device state. No deprecated Expo packages detected (uses expo-haptics, expo-image, expo-linear-gradient, react-native-keyboard-controller). One deprecation warning surfaced from RN Web (props.pointerEvents) but it's non-blocking.

minor.issue: Uppercases input but create endpoint already uses gen_code (uppercase alphabet). Lowercase URL requests still get normalized — OK, just noting.

ui_bugs.issue: STANDBY headline text is horizontally clipped on 390px viewport (first/last letter cut). Consider adjustResizeMode, smaller fontSize on small widths, or letterSpacing reduction.

integration_issues.issue: OBS WebSocket is ws:// while site is https:// → browsers block Mixed Content. Error surfaces to user as 'Failed to construct WebSocket'. Native app not affected. Consider suppressing native-only feature in the web preview with an inline hint 'Fonctionnalité disponible uniquement sur mobile natif'.

issues: Contrast and 8pt spacing look consistent; touch targets >= 44px on mode grid, call button, tab bar — OK

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely emitted by react-native-web or a dependency (LinearGradient/Image). Non-blocking but should be tracked.

action_items: (Optional/LOW) Fix STANDBY text clipping on /tally when device name is short — reduce letterSpacing or fontSize on small screens.
(Optional) On web build, hide/disable 'Connecter à OBS' with an explanatory notice about Mixed Content (native-only feature), because ws:// from https:// cannot succeed in browsers.
(Optional) Track down source of 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning (likely LinearGradient/Image wrapper) — cosmetic.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly separates REST + WS, uses Motor async, excludes MongoDB _id via clean(). Good.
WS alarm broadcast correctly excludes sender (exclude=device_id) when target=='all' — matches spec.
session.tsx uses persistent deviceId (expo-crypto UUID) and reconnects with 2.5s backoff — solid.
sendAlarm silently drops when WS not open (readyState!=1) but UI still shows 'ALERTE ENVOYÉE'. Consider guarding UI success only on send success (minor UX).
seed_data_creation: None persisted — all sessions/devices created with TEST_ prefix during pytest runs; no cleanup fixture required (ephemeral test DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are runnable via: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_studiotally.py -v. Use two Playwright contexts for realtime WS flows; navigate between tabs via tab-bar text click (Accueil/Régie/OBS/Alarme) instead of page.goto to preserve the WebSocket. On web preview, OBS connect will always fail with Mixed Content — verify ÉCHEC status + error banner only, do not expect success. EXPO_BACKEND_URL=https://multicam-tally-app.preview.emergentagent.com.
